fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled XPath/XPointer expression is read from the fuzz input; it can contain an id() call that triggers the vulnerable path.

fine_trace.code: doc = xmlReadMemory(xml, xmlSize, NULL, NULL, XML_PARSE_RECOVER);
fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled XML document is parsed in recovery mode; the document may contain ID attributes and XInclude constructs that cause nodes to be freed during processing.
The XPointer expression is evaluated against the parsed document; an id() expression invokes xmlXPathIdFunction.
The id() function resolves the string value to elements by calling xmlXPathGetElementsByIds with the document pointer.
xmlGetID returns a pointer to an attribute whose value matches the ID; this attribute may have been freed by earlier document processing (e.g. XInclude), leaving a dangling pointer.
Dereferences the possibly-freed attribute to obtain its parent element; if attr is dangling this reads freed heap memory.
The element pointer derived from the freed attribute is added to the node set; xmlXPathNodeSetAdd dereferences val->type, reading freed heap memory and causing the heap-use-after-free.
Reads val->type from the dangling element pointer, triggering the heap-use-after-free reported by the sanitizer.
